title: Implement bf stats breakdown by type, priority, and assignee
description: Phase 3.1. Currently cmd_stats prints totals by status but stubs out 'By type', 'By priority', and 'By assignee' sections. Implement the three additional breakdown queries: SELECT issue_type, COUNT(*) FROM issues GROUP BY issue_type; SELECT priority, COUNT(*) FROM issues GROUP BY priority; SELECT assignee, COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE assignee IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assignee.

title: Add secret_scanning.rs integration tests — all pattern categories covered
description: Test Strategy. Create tests/secret_scanning.rs with cases for each built-in deny_pattern: AWS access key AKIA..., RSA/EC private key header, OpenAI/Anthropic sk-... key. Verify bf create refuses write on match, prints warning with matching field. Verify allowlist_fields skips specified fields. Verify custom patterns from config.yaml are applied.

title: Implement bf migrate command in CLI — br→bf workspace migration (Path B)
description: Phase 4C-B. The migrate bead bf-8dd tracks the implementation but the Migrate subcommand is completely absent from src/cli/mod.rs. Add: 'bf migrate [<workspace>] [--from-jsonl] [--seed-velocity] [--dry-run]' to the Commands enum. Wire to src/migrate.rs (to be created). Migrate Path B: backup, apply_migrations, prime caches, seed config, verify forward/backward compat, release migration_lock.

title: Add integration tests: JSONL round-trip, schema compat, claim race
description: Plan §Test Strategy: Add tests/ directory with: jsonl_compat.rs (round-trip with br JSONL fixtures), schema_compat.rs (bf writes, br reads; br writes, bf reads), claim_race.rs (20-worker thundering herd), br_isolation.rs (verify bf never touches live br workspaces), secret_scanning.rs. Use tests/common/mod.rs TempWorkspace harness. Copy real workspace JSONL snapshots as read-only fixtures.

title: Verify NEEDLE uses bf labels instead of br show + label add loops
description: Plan §5.4-5.5: NEEDLE's labels() calls full br show to extract .labels (wasteful). bf labels <id> --json is a direct SELECT. Also check that NEEDLE batches label adds instead of N separate br label add invocations. The bf symlink makes both work but direct bf commands are faster.

title: bf velocity command is a stub — velocity_stats table never queried
description: Phase 4B.6. cmd_velocity in cli/mod.rs prints 'Velocity stats: (not yet implemented)'. The velocity_stats table schema exists but: (1) is never populated (see bf-2c2 for update-on-close), (2) is never queried. Implement SELECT model, harness, issue_type, sample_count, p50_seconds, p90_seconds, avg_seconds FROM velocity_stats ORDER BY model, harness, issue_type. Wire into bf-4qc bead.

title: Verify bf binary deployment: install to ~/.local/bin/bf and symlink br->bf
description: Phase 6.4. Deployment steps: download released bf binary (or build locally via cargo build --release), install to ~/.local/bin/bf, create symlink ln -sf ~/.local/bin/bf ~/.local/bin/br. Verify 'br list' in a NEEDLE workspace uses bf. Document in README. Add to bead-forge-build WorkflowTemplate output.

title: Velocity stats: update worker_sessions and velocity_stats on bf close
description: Phase 4B.6. When bf close <id> is called with --session-id <uuid>, update worker_sessions.closed_at and duration_seconds. Then recompute velocity_stats for the (model, harness, issue_type) tuple using a window over the last 50 sessions. Storage method: update_velocity_on_close(). Currently the schema and tables exist but are never populated.

title: Add br→bf migration checklist: per-machine install and per-workspace migrate loop
description: Phase 4C. Document and test the migration checklist from the plan: install bf binary, symlink br->bf, run 'bf migrate <workspace>' for each workspace (FORGE, NEEDLE, AgentScribe, ARMOR, SIGIL, CLASP, bead-forge). Add to README. Verify each migration passes bf doctor --check and br doctor.

title: Add rotate.rs module — implement closed bead eviction from active issues.jsonl
description: Phase 4B.1. The plan calls for src/rotate.rs but this file does not exist. The CLI has a stub. Create rotate.rs with: rotate_workspace(path, age_days, max_size_mb, max_archives) that streams active issues.jsonl, writes back only non-expired beads, appends expired closed beads to issues.jsonl.1 archive. Maintains archive file size limit with sequential shift.

title: Add batch_atomic.rs tests — verify transaction rollback on operation failure
description: Phase 4B.2 / Test Strategy. Create tests/batch_atomic.rs: test that a batch with an invalid operation in the middle rolls back all prior creates. Test that @-placeholder references work. Test that mitosis batch (2 creates + 2 dep_add_blocker + 1 close) is atomic. Verify kill -9 during batch leaves workspace in original state (SQLite rollback on reopen).

title: bf log <id> is a stub — event log query not implemented
description: Phase 4B.4. cmd_log in cli/mod.rs prints 'Event log for {id} (not yet implemented)'. The events table exists and is populated (CREATED, CLAIMED, CLOSED events are written). Implement the query: SELECT event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at FROM events WHERE issue_id=? ORDER BY created_at. Wire into bf-45g bead which tracks the full log command.

title: bf claim --fallback any: prefer workspace, fall back to cross-workspace if empty
description: Phase 4.5. Add --fallback=any option to Claim command. When the target --workspace is exhausted (no open beads), automatically falls back to claim --any across all registered workspaces. Distinct from --any which skips the preferred workspace entirely.

title: critical_path_cache: auto-invalidate and recompute on dep changes and status transitions
description: Phase 4B.5. Invalidate critical_path_cache for affected epic when a dependency is added/removed or a bead status changes. Recompute inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. Plan specifies: every dep_add_blocker/dep_remove_blocker side-effects a cache recompute. Also trigger on close/reopen. Currently critical_path.rs computes on demand but cache is not auto-refreshed.

title: Add src/migrate.rs module for br→bf workspace migration logic
description: Phase 4C. No migrate.rs module exists. Create it with: migrate_workspace_path_b() implementing backup, apply_migrations, prime caches, config seed, forward/backward compat verify. migrate_workspace_from_jsonl() for Path C with git log event reconstruction. Used by the CLI Migrate subcommand (bf-1az).

title: Implement bf log — operation history from events table
description: Plan §4B.4: Query events table for history of mutations on a specific bead or workspace. Support: bf log <id>, bf log --since <date>, bf log --actor <worker>, bf log --limit N, bf log --status-changes, bf log --diff (field-level diff). Output formatted event history with timestamps, actors, old/new values. Create src/log.rs. Update CLI cmd_log from placeholder.

title: Add JSONL test fixtures: tests/fixtures/ with forge-snapshot.jsonl and needle-snapshot.jsonl
description: Test Strategy. Create tests/fixtures/ directory with static JSONL snapshots copied from real workspaces (FORGE and NEEDLE). These read-only fixtures are the basis for JSONL round-trip and schema compat tests. Update tests/common/mod.rs TempWorkspace::from_fixture() to use them. Add copy instructions to test README.

title: Implement JSONL rotation archive shift logic (issues.jsonl.1 → .2 → .3)
description: Phase 4B.1. The Rotate command stub exists but only logs. Implement the full archive shift: when issues.jsonl.1 exceeds rotate_max_size_mb, shift .1->.2, .2->.3, etc. Delete oldest if exceeds rotate_max_archives. Write new archive via streaming append to issues.jsonl.1. Uses src/rotate.rs module (currently missing). bf show and bf list --all must search archive files.

title: Implement bf velocity — worker performance tracking and scoring
description: Plan §4B.6: Track duration per (model, harness, issue_type) in worker_sessions table (already in schema). On bf close, update session row with closed_at and duration_seconds. Compute velocity_stats from last 50 sessions per tuple. Integrate with claim scoring: score = impact / expected_seconds using velocity_stats. bf velocity command shows table of all known configurations. Create src/velocity.rs. Update CLI cmd_velocity from placeholder.

title: Fix: apply_migrations() must add workspace_path to worker_sessions if missing
description: Today's incident (2026-05-05): bead-forge workspace DB was missing workspace_path column in worker_sessions, causing all claims to fail with 'table worker_sessions has no column named workspace_path'. The apply_migrations() function must ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN workspace_path TEXT if the column doesn't exist. This is safe because br never reads worker_sessions. Add this to Storage::open migration path.

title: Implement bf rotate — JSONL log rotation
description: Plan §4B.1: Move closed beads older than rotate_age_days (default 30) from issues.jsonl into numbered archive files (issues.jsonl.1, .2, etc). Streaming rewrite of active file + streaming append to archive. Config: rotate_age_days, rotate_max_size_mb, rotate_max_archives. bf show must search archives. bf list --all must include archives. Create src/rotate.rs. Update CLI cmd_rotate from placeholder to working implementation.

title: Verify NEEDLE bead_store uses bf claim instead of br ready + br update
description: Plan §5.1-5.2: NEEDLE's bead_store/mod.rs currently chains br ready + br update (racy). Verify it uses bf claim (atomic) when bf is the br binary. Check lines 518-558 (claim) and 487-507 (ready→claim TOCTOU). If still using old two-call pattern, the bf symlink already makes it work but the race window remains until NEEDLE is updated to call bf claim directly.

title: Verify velocity-aware claim scoring uses velocity_stats in SELECT query
description: Phase 4B.6. The plan specifies the claim SELECT should JOIN velocity_stats for the requesting worker and compute score = (impact * 3.0 + priority * 2.0 + critical_path_bonus) / p50_seconds. Currently claim.rs uses simpler scoring without velocity data. Implement or verify the velocity-weighted scoring query from the plan §4B.6.

title: bf migrate --seed-velocity: populate velocity_stats from events history
description: Phase 4C. Add --seed-velocity flag to migrate command. After importing JSONL and reconstructing events, compute velocity_stats from reconstructed closed events that have known actor. Where actor name pattern (worker-claude-sonnet-4-6-01) can infer model, populate per-(model, harness, issue_type) averages. Fallback: populate (model=unknown, harness=unknown, issue_type) averages.

title: Implement bf commit-check — git pre-commit hook for staged .beads/ secret scanning
description: Phase 4B.1. Add CommitCheck subcommand that scans staged changes to .beads/ for secret patterns (AWS keys, private keys, API tokens) using same regex set as write-time scanner. Exits 1 on match with offending lines; 0 on clean. Document installation via .git/hooks/pre-commit.

title: bf doctor --reclaim-stale: manually reset expired in_progress beads without claiming
description: Phase 4.4. Add --reclaim-stale flag to Doctor command. Runs the same stale reset SQL (UPDATE issues SET status=open WHERE status=in_progress AND updated_at < now - claim_ttl) without claiming a bead afterward. Useful for workspaces with no active fleet. Optional --ttl flag to override config claim_ttl_minutes.

title: Add bead-forge-build Argo WorkflowTemplate to declarative-config
description: Plan §6.3: Add WorkflowTemplate to jedarden/declarative-config at k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/. Build Rust binary in container, push to ronaldraygun/bead-forge. Follow existing template patterns (spaxel-build, armor-build). Include cargo test step.

title: Implement bf critical-path — dependency DAG float computation
description: Plan §4B.5: Two-pass walk on dependency DAG using recursive CTEs. Forward pass computes earliest start (ES), backward pass computes latest start (LS). Float = LS - ES. Zero-float beads are on critical path. Populate critical_path_cache table (already in schema). Integrate with claim scoring: 1000.0 / (float + 1) bonus for zero-float beads. Recompute cache on dep add/remove. Create src/critical_path.rs. Update CLI cmd_critical_path from placeholder.

title: Implement bf schema command — show schema for a specific bead or workspace
description: Phase 3.1. Currently cmd_schema prints stub for target-specific schema. Implement: with no argument, print the SQLite schema DDL for all bf tables. With a bead ID argument, print that bead's full JSON representation including annotations. Useful for debugging and documenting the wire format.

title: Implement dep tree command — full dependency tree display
description: Phase 3.1. Currently cmd_dep_tree prints stub message. Implement recursive dependency tree walk using SQLite recursive CTE on the dependencies table. Display as indented tree with status indicators. Handle cycles (detect and break). Output formats: text (default), json.

title: Add br_isolation.rs integration test — verify bf never touches live br workspaces
description: Test Strategy Rule 1. Create tests/br_isolation.rs: verify that running bf commands in a tempdir never opens, reads, or modifies .beads/ from any parent directory (walk-up discovery must stop at tempdir boundary). Also verify bf sync --import-only with a fixture JSONL does not write to original JSONL path.

title: Implement bf migrate — explicit workspace migration with backup
description: Plan §4C: Three migration paths. Path B: bf migrate <workspace> [--dry-run] — pause fleet (migration_lock), backup beads.db, apply migrations, prime critical_path_cache, seed config defaults, verify br compat, verify bf compat, release fleet. Path C: bf migrate --from-jsonl — reimport from JSONL + reconstruct events from git log. Create src/migrate.rs. Update CLI cmd from placeholder.

title: Implement secret scanning before writes
description: Plan §4B.1 (secret protection section): Regex-based secret detection on all string fields before bf create/bf update. Patterns: AWS keys (AKIA...), private keys, API tokens (sk-...), passwords. Config in .beads/config.yaml secret_protection section. Create src/secrets.rs. Wire into create_issue and update_issue paths. Print warning and refuse write on match.

title: bf migrate --from-jsonl: reconstruct events table from git log
description: Phase 4C-C. When beads.db is missing or corrupted, migrate --from-jsonl reimports from issues.jsonl then reconstructs events by diffing git log --follow -p .beads/issues.jsonl commits. New bead appearing = synthetic created event. Status open->in_progress = synthetic claimed. Status->closed = synthetic closed + compute duration_seconds. Synthetic events get metadata.source=git-reconstructed.

title: Verify batch placeholder references (@0, @1) work for NEEDLE mitosis pattern
description: Phase 4B.2. The plan specifies @0, @1, etc. should resolve to IDs of beads created at that position in the batch. Critical for mitosis: create children first, then dep_add_blocker using @0 and @1. Check if src/batch.rs implements placeholder resolution. Write a test that exercises the mitosis pattern end-to-end using bf batch --json with @-references.
